newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan awards Mar MTBE tender to SABIC at $283/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan awards Mar MTBE tender to SABIC at $283/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought 7,000-tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for March 1-15 arrival from Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) at around $283 per tonne cost-and-freight Taiwan, industry sources said on Friday.
The tender, which sought 3,500-tonne cargoes to Kaohsiung or Taichung, closed January 22 and was valid for two days.
CPC's last spot tender was awarded at $275-$278 per tonne c-and-f, for December 1-15 delivery.
